To her right, the smiling girl with long brown hair (R8) in black overalls also leans in. In the background, the boy with glasses (R7) in a red shirt and the girl with curly hair (R2) in a red turtleneck look towards the camera. Bright indoor lighting illuminates the scene with a cheerful, soft palette.
